infoCards.title: Distribution Control
infoCards.description: Comprehensive distribution and retail channel management system.

faqData.question: How does the system handle demand forecasting?
faqData.answer: Our system uses advanced analytics and machine learning for accurate demand forecasting, considering seasonal trends, market dynamics and historical data.

faqData.question: What distribution features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes comprehensive distribution management with route optimization, retailer relationship management and real-time stock tracking across the supply chain.

faqData.question: Can it manage multiple product variants?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution handles multiple product variants, packaging options and SKUs with automated batch tracking and expiry date management.
